messages:
jamie: Kicking off RC creation for branch release/rc/2026-03-20. Need to pin numpy and kafka-client, and run canary. Change window: 2026-03-22 02:00-05:00 UTC. Asking for safety-gates + deadman switch config and sign-off.
vikram: noted — sha a1b2c3d4 is the build. deps to pin: numpy==1.25.2, kafka-client==2.4.1.
lena: QA here — will run smoke + regression job RG-197. Requesting a quick migration dry-run on staging before canary. ETA: staging run in 30m.
anna-pm: PM ack, release notes draft pushed to the docs repo. No user-facing breaking changes listed.
deploy-bot: RC created: rc-2026-03-20-1 \u2014 artifacts: s3://redwood/rc/a1b2c3d4.tar.gz. Preflight checks queued: container-scan, license-scan, integration-smoke.
jamie: preflight results needed before canary. If container-scan passes, we'll start 10% canary for 15m then evaluate.
qa-runner: staging dry-run started. failing test: ingest.tests.test_kafka_backpressure (flaky, investigating). Will re-run with increased timeout.
sre-oncall: Proposing deadman switch: auto-rollback if 1) error-rate > 1.0% over a 5m sliding window OR 2) p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m. Manual override allowed by oncall. Also recommend circuit breaker on write path.
jamie: agree to SRE thresholds. Add automatic metric alerting and Slack paging to #incidents. Please paste snippet for the rollback rule.
sre-oncall: Snippet:
```
deadman_switch:
  error_rate_threshold: 0.01
  error_window: 300  # seconds
  latency_multiplier: 2.0
  latency_window: 600
  action: auto_rollback
  notify: ["#incidents","sre-oncall"]
```
vikram: will wire that into deploy pipeline. Also enabling prefix/KV cache warmup for hot endpoints to avoid first-key latency spike.
lena: staging dry-run green after timeout bump. Regression suite RG-197 all green.
anna-pm: docs updated: release-notes/rc-2026-03-20-1.md, link: https://docs.internal/release-notes/rc-2026-03-20-1.md 
jamie: Canary plan: start 10% (15m) -> check errors/latency + business KPIs -> 50% (30m) -> full. Rollback window open during canary. Who's owning the canary watch?
lena: I can own canary watch for the first 45m. If anything weird, I will DM oncall and tag here.
sre-oncall: I'll be on standby. If deadman fires, I'll verify and execute rollback if needed. Also adding throttle fallback to older model variant on error spike.
qa-runner: I'll run the smoke regression after 10% is live and report status.
jamie: final checklist: pins applied, preflight green, deadman config added, canary owner assigned (lena), docs updated. If no objections, schedule deploy at 2026-03-22T02:15:00Z for canary kickoff.
vikram: LGTM from infra. I've pinned the runtime config and disabled auto-scaling burst for the canary window.
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: rc-2026-03-20-1 -> canary @ 2026-03-22T02:15:00Z. Rollback policy: auto (deadman) + manual. Preflight summary: container-scan: pass, license-scan: pass, integration-smoke: pass.
jamie: thanks everyone. If canary passes per gates we promote to 100% at ~03:10 UTC, otherwise rollback. I'll post a follow-up thread with final promote timestamp after canary check. :thumbsup:
lena: will post status here at +15m and +45m into canary.
qa-runner: will add results summary to this thread.
sre-oncall: oncall roster confirmed. Pager duty ready.
deploy-bot: NOTE: pinned deps recorded in release metadata: [\"numpy==1.25.2\", \"kafka-client==2.4.1\"]. Artifact SHA: a1b2c3d4.
jamie: closing for now, will reopen thread with live canary updates.
